Economy · India

India sees export opportunity amid US-Canada trade tensions

Amid escalating trade tensions between the United States and Canada, India is exploring potential export opportunities. The Economic Times reports that India is looking to fill gaps in the Canadian market that may arise from the trade dispute. International coverage highlights a renewed "Buy Canadian" movement, with consumers expressing a strengthened resolve to purchase domestic products. Some reports indicate that Canada's economy faces risks, including potential job losses and recession, if the trade war with the US continues and the USMCA pact ends.
